name: gaussianedit-orchestration
description: Dispatches one existing GaussianEdit catch-up job through its authenticated board and the documented GitHub Codex trigger.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch one GaussianEdit catch-up job safely.
interface.longDescription: Reads the authenticated GaussianEdit board, prioritizes existing system backlog before product work, and uses a draft GitHub pull request plus one idempotent @codex comment to start cloud work.
defaultPrompt: Use $dispatch-cloud-work to dispatch at most one eligible GaussianEdit catch-up job.
Prioritize existing system work, then product work, and return NOOP when neither a new job nor a clean handoff is eligible.
